title: Arabic MSA conversational dependency tree
root: Hold useful short conversations with a new MSA speaker
leaf_rule: Each beat branches into L (understand a changed audio prompt), P (produce a relevant reply aloud), I (choose and ask a relevant follow-up), and R (recover when a key word is unclear). These are separate observable actions, never automatic completions of one another.

contexts.title: Languages and comprehension
beats: ask which language the partner speaks
request repetition and answer after it

contexts.title: People and relationships
beats: say who is present or absent
introduce two people to each other

contexts.title: Study and work
beats: say where one works or studies
describe a simple work or study task

contexts.title: Daily routine
beats: say what one does in the morning
say what one is doing now
contrast today with a usual day
describe a short sequence of activities

contexts.title: Places nearby
beats: recognize left right and straight ahead
confirm that the destination was understood

contexts.title: Getting around
beats: say where one wants to go
check that one has the correct route

contexts.title: Food and drink
beats: say what one would like to drink

contexts.title: At a café
beats: ask for the price or bill
check an order when it is repeated

contexts.title: Shopping
beats: ask whether an item is available
confirm the item and total before paying

contexts.title: Home and accommodation
beats: ask about a room or place to stay
confirm an address or room number

contexts.title: Weather and clothing
beats: give a simple reason for clothing
revise a plan after a weather update

contexts.title: Health and needs
beats: repeat or clarify an important symptom

contexts.title: Invitations and plans
beats: invite someone to a simple activity
decline politely with a short reason
suggest a different time or place

contexts.title: Opinions and choices
beats: reach and confirm a shared choice
